question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?

details.reason: Complete results differ from Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 0.0
details.actual_sql:
WITH customer_2013 AS (
  SELECT
    ym.customer_id,
    c.segment,
    SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption,
    AVG(ym.consumption) AS annual_avg_consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c
    ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.date >= '201301'
    AND ym.date <= '201312'
  GROUP BY ym.customer_id, c.segment
),
least_consumers AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    customer_id,
    total_consumption,
    annual_avg_consumption,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY segment
      ORDER BY total_consumption ASC, customer_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM customer_2013
),
segment_averages AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
    MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
    MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
  FROM least_consumers
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  sme_avg,
  lam_avg,
  kam_avg,
  sme_avg - lam_avg AS sme_minus_lam,
  lam_avg - kam_avg AS lam_minus_kam,
  kam_avg - sme_avg AS kam_minus_sme
FROM segment_averages;
details.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'SME' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'LAM' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'LAM' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'KAM' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'KAM' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'SME' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.currency = 'CZK' AND T2.consumption = (SELECT MIN(consumption) FROM yearmonth) AND CAST(T2.date AS TEXT) BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
